description:
0.88.0: your own line of an agreement you are in (who, the SHA-256 agreed, when) as a leaf, with its Merkle
        proof against the day's root that hashn wrote to the chain. Works with or without the workspace. Agreements
        are anchored once a day; until then the answer has the leaf and `anchored: false`. Keep the answer with your
        copy of the agreed file: together they show that hashn recorded your agreeing to those bytes, at that time, no
        later than that day's root, and can't have changed it since. `leaf_text` is the exact text that is hashed.

agreement_id.description: The agreement's id (a UUID), from list_agreements or the `entry` of an agree answer.
agreement_id.title: Agreement Id

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

name: agreement_proof
